title: Subarray Sum Equals K
statement: Count the contiguous subarrays whose values sum to exactly k. Values may be negative, so a sliding window does not work here.
constraints: the sliding-window trick needs non-negative values; this problem does not have them
hints: Write P[j] for the sum of the first j elements. The subarray from i to j-1 sums to P[j] - P[i].
So you want to count pairs i < j with P[j] - P[i] == k. Rearranged: for each j, how many earlier prefixes equal P[j] - k?
One pass, a running sum, and a Dictionary from prefix value to how many times you have seen it. Seed it with 0 mapped to 1 so subarrays starting at index 0 get counted.
